ideas.pitch: An Eightfold.ai-aligned talent intelligence platform combining graph neural networks and explainable ML to detect fraudulent candidate profiles and credential inflation in enterprise hiring.
ideas.title: TalentGraph AML & Skill Risk Intelligence Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Since Eightfold.ai is co-hosting the hackathon and focusing on ML-driven talent solutions, this project directly targets their core domain while using advanced graph intelligence patterns inspired by winning AML platforms.

ideas.pitch: A machine learning prediction engine using Poisson GAMs to forecast workplace compliance violations, bias incidents, and attrition risks with calibrated prediction intervals.
ideas.title: IncidentAI Safety Forecaster for Enterprise HR Compliance
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates rigorous statistical modeling and rigorous risk forecasting rather than a basic wrapper, aligning with Eightfold's enterprise focus on responsible, compliant AI.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace built with USDC escrow on Base that matches employees with internal gig projects and upskilling pathways based on verified skill graphs.
ideas.title: SkillTrace Autonomous Agent Marketplace for Internal Mobility
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines cutting-edge agentic workflows with Eightfold's core mission of talent mobility, making it stand out among standard LLM wrapper projects.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered video intelligence platform that transforms unstructured candidate interview recordings into searchable, bias-audited skill assessments and insights.
ideas.title: SkillVision Video Intelligence Platform for Interview Analytics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles unstructured multimodal data processing, giving judges a tangible, highly polished product that solves a massive pain point in recruitment.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven credential verification and patient acquisition engine tailored for specialized medical institutions to streamline practitioner onboarding and trust building.
ideas.title: ClinMatch AI-Powered Healthcare Talent & Patient Trust Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages rapid verticalized AI patterns from successful hackathon winners to present a complete, deployment-ready vertical SaaS application.
